import polars as pl

NULL_VALUES = ["", "N/A", "n/a", "-", "null"]

def transform(raw: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return raw.select(
        device_id=pl.col("SERIAL").str.to_uppercase(),
        read_at=pl.col("TIMESTAMP")
        .str.to_datetime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", strict=False)
        .dt.cast_time_unit("us"),
        temperature_c=pl.col("TEMP_C")
        .replace(NULL_VALUES, None)
        .cast(pl.Float64, strict=False)
        .round(2),
        humidity_pct=pl.col("RH")
        .replace(NULL_VALUES, None)
        .cast(pl.Float64, strict=False)
        .round(2),
        battery_v=pl.col("VBAT")
        .replace(NULL_VALUES, None)
        .cast(pl.Float64, strict=False)
        .round(2),
    )
